basic_details.job_title: DoP Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 Young Professionals, Young Professional Posts
basic_details.short_information: Two contractual Young Professional positions are open in the Department of Pharmaceuticals (DoP), Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers, New Delhi, at a fixed remuneration of Rs.70,000 per month: one Young Professionals post and one Young Professionals cum Graphic/Video Editor post, both listed under the Media Cell. Applicants need a relevant Master's Degree, must not exceed 32 years of age as on 31.10.2026, and pay no application fee. Applications on the prescribed form go by Speed Post, by hand or by email to [email protected] and should reach the department on or before 4 December 2026 (Adv

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted using the prescribed form. Applications complete in all respects should reach the department on or before 4 December 2026, by either of the two methods below.
Get the prescribed application form from https://pharma-dept.gov.in/recruitment; it is also printed with the advertisement.
In Part A of the form, tick the post applied for (Young Professionals or Young Professionals cum Graphic/Video Editor) and cross the other.

Fill in the basic details, contact details, education (graduation/diploma level and above, in reverse chronological order), employment or consultancy history, other experience, publications or awards, any past conviction or pending criminal case, referees and last remuneration.

Affix a recent passport size photograph and sign across it, then sign the declaration, which confirms that you have read the Young Professionals guidelines dated 12.06.2026 and agree to abide by them.

By hard copy: send the form by Speed Post or hand it in, in a sealed cover, to Office of Under Secretary (E&A), Department of Pharmaceuticals, G-19, Shastri Bhawan, New Delhi, addressed to Under Secretary (E&A), Department of Pharmaceuticals, G-19, Shastri Bhawan, New Delhi. Hand delivery is during working hours on a working day.
By email: send the application to [email protected].
The form's subject line reads: "Application for engagement of Young Professional, invited vide Department of Pharmaceuticals' Advertisement no. 07/2026, Issue date: 17.11.2026".
Recent passport size photograph, affixed on the form and signed across.
Signed additional sheet for employment or consultancy details, if required.
Supporting documents for publications, recognition, awards, briefs, journals or research papers listed in the form.
important_instructions: Only applications on the prescribed form, complete in all respects, are accepted. The Division mentioned for each post is indicative; DoP will have the right to deploy the YP to any other Division. The YP is engaged as a consultant and will not be regarded for any purposes as an employee or representative of DoP. Terms of engagement follow the DoP Young Professionals guidelines dated 12.06.2026, as may be amended from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The detailed description for the Young Professionals cum Graphic/Video Editor post names the Coordination and Parliament Division as the place of deployment. For both posts, the notice states that the Division mentioned is indicative and that DoP will have the right to deploy the YP to any other Division. The place of work for both posts is the Department of Pharmaceuticals (DoP), Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers, New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Qualification: A candidate must possess the Master's Degree in Journalism/Mass Communication from a recognised University/Institution. Age: Not exceeding 32 years of age as on 31.10.2026. Qualification: A candidate must possess any of the following qualifications from a recognised University/Institution: Master's Degree in Public Relations/Graphic Design/Animation/Multimedia and Communication or a related field. Desirable: Minimum of 02 years of relevant experience. Desirable: The candidate shall possess and maintain access to a professional quality camera or a smartphone with high resolution camera capabilities suitable for photography and videography required for official assignments. Age: Not exceeding 32 years of age as on 31.10.2026. The notice requires the following attributes of applicants for both posts: The ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and meet deadlines. Good command over language (English & Hindi), use of design softwares and video/still photography. Well versed in use of various social media platforms. Good knowledge and skill in the use of office productivity applications such as word processing, spreadsheets and presentation software, along with strong communication, analytical and presentation skills. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: Master's Degree in Journalism/Mass Communication from a recognised University/Institution
Master's Degree in Public Relations/Graphic Design/Animation/Multimedia and Communication or a related field, from a recognised University/Institution

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Both posts carry a fixed monthly remuneration of Rs.70,000/- per month. The YP will be a consultant, engaged on whole-time basis. The notice states that nothing in the contract of engagement will be construed as establishing, constituting or implying an employer-employee or principal-agent relationship between DoP and the YP, and that the YP will not be regarded for any purposes as an employee or representative of DoP. Other terms and conditions will be governed by the Guidelines for engagement of Young Professionals on contract basis of the Department of Pharmaceuticals, issued vide F. no. A-41011/01/2021-Estt. (E- 16596) dated 12.06.2026, as may be amended from time to time. These guidelines, as they currently stand, may be accessed on the DoP website at https://pharma-dept.gov.in/recruitment . The length of the engagement is not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: DoP Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice prints the same role and responsibilities for both posts. The YP will work as an executive assistant and provide administrative support and high-quality inputs towards analysis, planning, execution, verification and reporting in the related field, and will liaise with various Divisions in DoP, with other Ministries/Departments concerned and with State Governments, including their organisations and agencies, as required. Responsibilities for both posts include: Monitoring of Print/Electronic/Social media platforms and content creation for print media. Developing engaging text posts for social media platforms including Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube and X. Graphic Designing support for creating posters, banners, infographics and other publicity material for social media platforms. Creation of reels, short videos and videos for campaigns, events etc. Carrying out of such other duties and tasks as may be entrusted from time to time.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DoP Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted using the prescribed form. Applications complete in all respects should reach the department on or before 4 December 2026, by either of the two methods below. Recent passport size photograph, affixed on the form and signed across. Signed additional sheet for employment or consultancy details, if required. Supporting documents for publications, recognition, awards, briefs, journals or research papers listed in the form.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DoP Recruitment 2026?

faq.answer: Applications complete in all respects should reach the Department of Pharmaceuticals on or before 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the DoP Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: Young Professionals need a Master's Degree in Journalism/Mass Communication; Young Professionals cum Graphic/Video Editor need a Master's Degree in Public Relations/Graphic Design/Animation/Multimedia and Communication or a related field, both from a recognised University/Institution.

faq.answer: Applicants for both posts must be not exceeding 32 years of age as on 31.10.2026.

faq.answer: Both posts carry a fixed monthly remuneration of Rs.70,000/- per month.

faq.answer: No, the application fee is Nil for both posts.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the DoP Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed form and send it by Speed Post or by hand in a sealed cover to the Office of Under Secretary (E&A), Department of Pharmaceuticals, G-19, Shastri Bhawan, New Delhi, or by email to [email protected].

faq.answer: No, the YP is engaged as a consultant on whole-time basis and will not be regarded for any purposes as an employee or representative of DoP.

faq.answer: A minimum of 02 years of relevant experience, and access to a professional quality camera or a smartphone with high resolution camera capabilities for official photography and videography.
